clauses.title: The CLI declares commit_create and push_publish and their inputs
created is workspace_create data and captured is the operator_capture envelope
The batch commits and pushes through the packaged operations; parent is the captured head for the first batch and the run's last pushed head after
requires: const commit = step('commit_create', { created: s.created, captured: s.captured, message: b.message }).commit;
const pushed = run.op('push_publish', { created: s.created, captured: s.captured, parent: b.parentHead }, { allowFail: true });

clauses.title: The push checks the parent descends from the captured head with HEAD its sole child
requires: fail('guard_failed', 'the parent does not descend from the captured public head', phase
fail('guard_failed', 'HEAD is not a single commit on the head the batch built on', phase, { parents, parent: base });

clauses.title: The capture records the operator identity and refuses a missing or unusable one
The commit carries the captured identity and the push names one helper without force
requires: HEAD does not descend from the captured public head

clauses.title: CL-D89 records the identity, the helper, and the superseded CL-D37 clause
clauses.section: ## CL-D89 — The writer commits and pushes through packaged operations with the operator identity
requires: *Owner choice:* Option A for the identity
naming a second credential helper, admitting an SSH or other non-https remote, adding force in any form, or letting anything but the writer invoke either operation requires a new owner decision.
